summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Google Sheets/Docs integration for Operations Module. All 15 backend API tests passed. All 13 frontend features tested and working correctly.

issues: Console shows CSP errors when embedding Google Docs (expected behavior due to Google's frame-ancestors policy). Documents still load correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: OperationsPage.js is now 2164 lines - strongly recommend splitting into separate component files: GoogleDocPanel, AddDocumentModal, DocumentChip, ByProjectView
The embed URL generation could be moved to a utility function for reusability
seed_data_creation: Test documents created during testing. Existing data: 'Sample Content Calendar' on Dew Clinic project, 'Test Budget Sheet' on Drawlead project
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google Docs/Sheets integration fully implemented and tested. Features: 1) FileSpreadsheet icon button on each project in By Project view, 2) Add Document modal with URL detection (shows 'Google Sheet detected' or 'Google Doc detected'), 3) Invalid URL validation, 4) Document chips in 'Linked Documents' section, 5) Split view panel with embedded document, 6) Split view header with Refresh/Open in Google/Fullscreen/Close buttons, 7) Document removal via X button on chip. Backend APIs: GET/POST/DELETE /api/notion/projects/{id}/documents all working.
